scope: File-only inventory of retained alpha.3.2 evidence; no new runtime validation or completion claim.
statusRule: Latest recorded attempt; a separate terminal record takes precedence over a preserved running checkpoint. A recorded pass is scoped to its receipt and tested source. Historical failures remain retained.

terminalRecords.scope: Native journal proves its release acknowledgment; full independent follow-up and terminal cleanup receipt were not completed.
terminalRecords.remaining: Foreground input accessibility and complete acceptance remain unverified; no passing case is claimed.

originalRecoveryCells.qualification: Original running checkpoint is preserved; separate termination record reports blocked. No passing case is claimed.

terminalRecords.reason: Outer orchestrator returned exit code1 after writing the display/plan and before creating a case receipt or launching the case. Exact subprocess error output was not retained; no failed input is inferred.

originalRecoveryCells.qualification: Original preparation-only not_run is retained separately from the first actual execution, whose receipt and matrix both report pass.

limitations: Plan declarations of outsideScope are historical and do not override later separate stop or quarantine receipts.
All statuses describe recorded acceptance evidence, not current live input state.
No secrets, private control-file paths, raw clipboard metadata, or raw event contents are reproduced.
